hero.badge: For churches and small groups in Indonesia
hero.title: Your church is growing. Its admin shouldn't grow with it.
hero.body: gembala brings members, small groups, service schedules, worship, and events into one platform, so you can focus on what matters most: your people.
hero.note: Ready to use in 15 minutes. No install.

features.title: One place to care for your people, not five apps
features.subtitle: Built with church and small group leaders, not accountants.

members.title: Know every member
members.body: Family, birthdays, baptism status, and small group all in one profile.

scheduling.title: Service scheduling without the drama
scheduling.body: Build the volunteer rotation for each service in minutes. Everyone knows who's serving from the start.

worship.title: Worship ready ahead of time
worship.body: Theme, scripture, order of service, songs, and volunteers linked together.

events.title: Events and rooms, sorted
events.body: Retreats, catechism classes, and other events go on a shared calendar with the room they use.

groups.title: Small groups you can see into
groups.body: Pastors know which groups are thriving and which members are becoming less visible.

care.title: No prayer or care need slips through
care.body: Log prayer and care needs, then close them with a note once they're handled.

journey.title: Faith journeys made visible
journey.body: From first visit to catechism, baptism, and leadership potential. The next step is clear for everyone.

notes.title: Pastoral notes stay private
notes.body: Private notes are visible only to the author and the pastor. They never appear in lists or exports.

telegramSection.title: Log attendance as easily as sending a message
telegramSection.body: After small group, just type who showed up. The gembala assistant understands everyday language, asks for confirmation before saving, and answers questions about your members.

list.log: Log attendance and add new guests from chat
list.ask: Ask who hasn't come in a while
list.notes: Write pastoral notes while they're still fresh

chat.ariaLabel: Example conversation with the gembala assistant
chat.me1: Today's youth small group attendance: Budi, Sari, Dewi present. Andi excused, sick.
chat.bot1Present: ✓ Present: Budi Santoso, Sari Wijaya, Dewi Natalia
chat.me2: Yes. Who hasn't come in the last 2 weeks?

privacy.title: Member data is a trust, not an asset
privacy.body: Every church gets its own isolated data space. Leaders only see members matching the tags they've been given, and every change is logged.

isolated.title: Isolated per church
isolated.body: No other church can see your data — not even the gembala team.

tags.title: Tag-based access
tags.body: A youth group leader only sees youth members. Nothing more.

safe.title: Safe when leaders change
safe.body: Access is revoked instantly — data and notes stay safe with the church.

verse.quote: I know my sheep and my sheep know me.

finalCta.title: Start shepherding better
finalCta.body: Create your church account, add your first small group, and log your first meeting today.
finalCta.madeBy: Built by church members, for churches in Indonesia.

pain.body: Service rosters in Excel. Confirmations across 5 WhatsApp groups. Member data scattered through the office ledger. The drummer finds out Saturday night that he's on.
pain.question: Sound familiar?

pastor.message: Know who needs a visit this week.

coordinator.message: Roster done in 10 minutes, not 3 days.

volunteer.worry: Learning the schedule at the last minute
volunteer.message: Your duty is clear from the start, no more Saturday-night surprises.
